notes.title: UPDATE 1.3
notes.content:
UPDATE 1.3

-Korean Language update.
The updated professional translation for the Korean language has been added.
-Rearranged dwarf crafting stations so they can motivate each other. (So you can reach all of the tables easier in order to sell more efficiently).
-Slightly slowed panning speed.
-Changed all EXTRAS category items to now be some form of equippable item such as belts, cloaks, weapons, trinkets etc. (shields are 'cloaks' because when a shield is stored it's usually on the back).
-A lot of recipes have been rebalanced a bit to make it so they utilize a more balance of ingredients through all of the recipes of one cave tier type.
-Stack size for all ingredients has been increased to 50.
-Recipes in lists now show a "Shop Level" separator to help know what level they were unlocked at. (Good for quick comparisons when crafting).
-Ingredient display for caves has been added. It shows to the left of each cave/tier in the bottom area.
-Clicking on an ingredient in the inventory will now display what cave/tier it came from.
-Clicking on a recipe in the recipe list will now tell you which cave/tier the ingredients come from.
-Increased effectiveness of the 'chance to get a tip (in gold) from station stats.
-Increased base chance to critical craft (not the luck stat but your raw chance). Should be easier to fill out all of your colors now or to get lucky on some upgrades.
-Increased the effectiveness of the LUCK stat on all dwarf stations (not Miner).

notes.title: UPDATE v1.2
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE v1.2[/b]

----------------------
Quality of Life
----------------------

[b]-The game will now work out of focus.
-You can now see the level associated with a Cave/Tier once you've unlocked them.
-Edge scrolling can now be used. Right click and drag still works as well.
-Craft Times have been shortened across the game.
-Various recipes have had their ingredients reduced and/or spread out to help crafting towards the end of the game.
-Various late game recipes have had their stats rearranged or increased to help the end-game flow.
-After level 12 enemies now have a chance to drop up to 3 ingredients instead of 2.
-After level 18 enemies now have a chance to drop up to 4 ingredients instead of 3.
-Wood/Ore can now stack to 20 (up from 10).
-A lot of the quests have had their objectives shortened slightly.
-Moods can now be seen under the 'last sold' on the Sale item display.
-Leveling will now unlock additional inventory slots. 1 each level until level 20.[/b]

-The "For Sale" toggle has been moved below the price to make it more obvious. It also now says "Sell:" to try to alleviate any confusion around it.
-You will no longer sell gigantic items.
-We've made the tiers more obvious with bigger gold arrows.
-Tier messages have been added to the level up for when you unlock one.
-Russian flag has been corrected.
-Some of the Ore graphics have been changed to make them more distinguishable.
-Extras category items no longer have stats to avoid any confusion on being able to equip them.
-A tutorial for the speed icons has been added. (Top center near shop level starting at level 5).
-Station names have been added to the unlock area to make them more clearly associated with their matching quests.
-Enchanter unlock price reduced slightly.
-Various other bug fixes and QOL improvements.

notes.title: UPDATE v1.1
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE v1.1[/b]

-Various bug fixes.
-Items that are not marked "For Sale" and on a table will now turn red to be a quick indicator.
-Escape can now be used from all windows. Including closing the options screen.
-Hotkeys have been assigned to the Dwarf windows. You can see the key below the icon.
-You can now left click on a station to open the Dwarf's Crafting Window, and Left click on the flag of the station to open their equipment.
-The base speed of the game has been raised slightly, and the speed unlocks you accrue have gained some speed to match.
-The Achievement for drinking 50 mead should now work properly. Time to get drunk!
-You can now see your Attract A Dragon quest and gold goal for that from level one.
-Your miner inventory should now properly stack into your storage inventory if you have room in your stacks.

-Added tutorial tab for new red items.
-Added tutorial tab specifying you can click on items to see their tooltips.
